column1: # Contains GeoNames data (geonames.org, CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): this file is a derived
# work of GeoNames' admin1CodesASCII.txt and is excluded from the repository's CC0 dedication; attribution: GeoNames
# (geonames.org). The ISO 3166-2 codes come from Wikidata (query.wikidata.org, CC0).
# GeoNames first-level codes to ISO 3166-2 (moqui_lib::geo::admin1, plans/Maps.md §6.3): `{country}.{GeoNames admin1
# code}`, a tab, and the ISO 3166-2 subdivision code after its `{country}-`. GeoNames' first-level codes are FIPS 10-4 (or
# GeoNames' own where FIPS has none) for every country but the US, Switzerland, Belgium and Montenegro, whose codes are ISO
# and are not listed. A code not listed has no known ISO code: the importer matches it by name, else makes {country}_A1_{code}.
# Derived November 25, 2026 by joining download.geonames.org/export/dump/admin1CodesASCII.txt on each division's geonameid
# with the ISO 3166-2 code (P300, best rank) of the Wikidata item carrying that GeoNames ID (P1566): 3,367 of GeoNames'
# 3,865 divisions matched, 3,263 of them in the countries listed here. Changed by hand: three with two current codes on
# Wikidata (AZ.30 LA, the city of Lankaran; OM.02 BJ and OM.04 SJ, the 2011 codes) and one of two divisions given the same code (AZ.56, the city of
# Shusha, kept as SUS; AZ.55 left out); three the join missed added (IN.12 JK, IN.41 LA, IN.52 DH). 3,265 rows. About 500
# divisions have none, most in dependencies with no ISO subdivisions and in countries whose divisions changed after
# their ISO codes (Vietnam's 2025 provinces, Morocco's regions). Checked against Mantle's install data: every Canadian,
# Indian, Japanese and Portuguese first-level division's code is a value here (moqui-lib geo tests).
